author: Mesa Independent
title: HonorHealth announces new name for Mountain Vista Medical Center - NewsBreak
text:
18 hours ago
HonorHealth, a Valley-based nonprofit health care system serving more than five million people in the greater Phoenix area, on Oct. 1 announced that Mountain Vista Medical Center in Mesa will officially be renamed HonorHealth Four Peaks Medical Center.
The medical center is at 1301 S. Crismon Road in Mesa.
The name change reflects a new chapter for this hospital and HonorHealth’s commitment to expanding access to high-quality care in the East Valley, according to a release.
Opened in 2007 and acquired by HonorHealth in October 2024, the 178-bed hospital delivers advanced medical services ranging from Level III trauma and primary stroke care to robotic-assisted surgeries, orthopedics, cardiology, labor and delivery, behavioral health and more.
“Renaming Mountain Vista to HonorHealth Four Peaks Medical Center represents more than a new sign on the building,” Todd LaPorte, CEO of HonorHealth, said in the release. “It symbolizes a renewal; it’s our commitment to blending nationally recognized clinical expertise with the warmth and trust people expect from their community hospital. It’s all built off a team of professionals who have been dedicated to caring for this community for years. As the East Valley continues to grow, this medical center will grow right alongside it — ensuring that families here have access to expert care close to home.”
The medical center is recognized as a Level III Trauma Center, Primary Stroke Center and a Cardiac Receiving Center, with accreditations including Stroke Gold Plus and Chest Pain Center designation.
“While our name is changing, our commitment to the community is stronger than ever,” Preston Allred, hospital administrator for HonorHealth Four Peaks Medical Center, said in the release. “We’re proud to be a trusted resource for East Valley families — whether that’s welcoming a new life in our birthing center, providing advanced emergency and cardiac services, or behavioral health support for seniors, we’re here for every stage of life. This new chapter ensures we can deliver exceptional care while being even more connected to the HonorHealth system.”
More information about HonorHealth Four Peaks Medical Center can be found at https://www.honorhealth.com/find-a-location.
